After a leadership change, pipeline expectations tend to reset fast, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new target. The gap shows up late, and recovering a quarter is far harder than covering it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PandaDoc needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
